name: magnetic-button
title: Magnetic Button
description: A button that leans toward the pointer while it hovers, then springs back when it leaves.
behaviour: While the pointer moves over the button, the button eases toward it by strength times the pointer's distance from its centre, and the label travels a little further by depth, which reads as depth. When the pointer leaves, both spring back to rest over duration with the chosen ease. Movement uses gsap.quickTo, so a fast-moving pointer costs one tween per axis rather than one per event. The effect only switches on where there is a precise pointer that can hover, so on phones and tablets it behaves as an ordinary button, and it never moves the hit area away from a tap. Every other prop, including onClick and disabled, passes straight through to the button element. Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce it never moves.
